agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the sentence about refreshing their memory, "Not a house, not a castle, friend.", and "A TENT."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The earlier cards only establish that Peter and the others heard the voice themselves. They provide no context from which the baker can reason out "mountain" rather than "temple" or "river," so this blank asks for wording the baker has not seen.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The answer stops with the morning star rising, and no card includes the important detail that it rises "in your hearts" from 2 Peter 1:19. That part of the verse is therefore never taught.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
